description: Workstation cluster (de-probabilised, game cast on a reliability CTMC). The repair unit (coalition) keeps the minimum quality of service (at least N operational workstations) satisfied forever by restoring failed workstations, whatever the failures -> expected TRUE. The sub-cluster size N and the QoS threshold are arbitrary (input("env"), not fixed in advance). Qualitative core of the rPATL QoS/reliability objective.
